_comment: Which prefabs count as a harvestable resource, for the harvest-vs-regrowth series.
Data, not code, for two reasons. Modded servers add prefabs this repo has never seen, and
the classifier cannot help here: Categories.NATURE is never assigned on a real world (every
tree and rock carries a property flag and falls through to UNKNOWN), so grouping has to be
by name. Names come from PrefabDictionary, which validates every entry against the same
stable hash the parser reads, so a name here is a real prefab or it matches nothing.
Patterns are Java regexes matched against the prefab name, case-insensitively. First
matching group wins, so order matters: put the specific ahead of the general.
The 'seen' field on each group lists names actually observed in this repo's corpus. It is
documentation, not configuration - it exists so a reader can tell which patterns are
grounded in observed data and which are carried for worlds we have not looked at yet.
